determinism.method: The release was cut on a base read live THREE ways and the ask's bytes were checked against the sha256 the GO names, so the halves demonstrably cover these bytes. The two grants were applied ONE AT A TIME with an IAM read-back between them, and the second policy was proven ABSENT at the moment the first was read back, so the ordering is measured rather than asserted. The refusal arm uses TWO counters because the thirteen read two different stores.

mutant.description: The order names no mutant. Four negative arms stand in its place. (a) The refusal arm replaces the scope seam's S3 client AND the news path's DynamoDB client with counters that RAISE on any attribute access -- TWO counters, because one would have left the five news tools unguarded while still reporting a clean zero, which is a pass produced by not looking. (b) The G3 grant's resource list is DERIVED by AST and the generator REFUSES unless three independent readings of the bucket agree and unless the existing grant's Resource list is identical in the .tf and in live IAM -- a grant computed against a fiction would otherwise pass every static check and fail only at runtime. (c) The host-shaped import check runs at 4-parent depth, where OG-ap-18 v1's parents[5] was fatal, and it is what caught the missing seam. (d) The collapse of 3 residue prefixes to 1 is asserted rather than eyeballed: the generator refuses if any dropped prefix lacks a covering kept one.

declared_exclusions.item: the CVO's ALB condition -- the AUTHENTICATED read of the thirteen through mcp.opalinvest.dev
declared_exclusions.reason: What the condition turns on IS measured: every one of the thirteen runs far under the 60 s idle timeout (slowest news_for_security 7.29 s, the rest under 1 s, no 502/504), so the STOP arm has nothing to fire on. What was NOT done is the authenticated end-to-end call. The edge answers an unauthenticated POST /mcp with 401 and www-authenticate: Bearer, so it needs a per-user delegated token, and minting or sharing one is stop-the-line under the gateway's access policy. This seat holds a live authenticated connection to that endpoint -- whoami returns a real Opal identity through the ALB -- but its tool catalogue predates this deploy and cannot be refreshed without a client reconnect this seat cannot force. Owed by a client whose catalogue post-dates the deploy, naturally the CVO's own.

data_status on a quiet day was not sought, and the 14-day news cap was READ out of the module (WINDOW_CAP_DAYS = 14) rather than demonstrated by tripping it. The probes were synthetic and argument-shaped, not an analyst's question, so the precondition is proven and the judgment is not claimed.

declared_exclusions.reason: audit.log_call -> _emit -> put_object whenever AUDIT_S3_BUCKET is set, and this order's BOUNDS say no object is written to any bucket, so the harness replaced the sink with an in-process recorder. The admission, the tools and the scope seam ran as installed.

A2 ruled it not required and tolerated it either way, but the COO half was already signed at ee23dd004c and adding any file would move that sha. It was run as EVIDENCE (4 passed) and removed, with HEAD equal and git status empty verified afterwards -- so the coverage claim is earned without moving a signed artifact. Row Z-S138.
